Yet when Su Xue saw Chu Tian transform using the red beetle…

To the dearly missed Miss Helen.
I practiced my handwriting a great deal to make a good impression on you.
I simply couldn’t bring myself to send you a letter in ugly script.
I hope the magic I send this time will please you.

After dying in an accident, Qiao Xia wakes up inside a cliché “run away with the baby” novel.

Qiao Xia finds this deeply unreasonable.
When he demands to know why he was chosen for such a role, the system calmly informs him that he was selected because he is exceptionally skilled at “running away with the baby.”
Qiao Xia is outraged.
The only reason he’s good at that is because he used to play football.
Unfortunately, fate refuses to listen.
Despite his determination to avoid the plot, he and Yan Yunxi end up together anyway. To make matters worse, the male lead is exactly the kind of man who is difficult to resist, handsome, distant, composed, and so untouchably perfect that conquering him feels like a challenge.
Before long, the romance happens exactly as the novel intended.
What doesn’t happen according to plan is everything afterward.
The moment the tragic love story is about to begin, Qiao Xia grabs the baby and runs.
Then he keeps running.
For six whole years.
